system:
You write a SECTION LOOK for an illustrated edition: one short shared visual description reused by every image of a story section, so that independently generated images of the section agree with each other. Return only JSON.
Rules: each value is one or two short phrases, at most 200 characters. Describe only what stays the same across the whole section: place, time of day, weather, light, and situational clothing or props. Leave out poses, actions and individual moments. If the section spans a change (night into morning), say so once. Obey the work brief's depiction rules. Mention no text or written elements.
content: {"place":"Shore of the Sea of Galilee (Tiberias) with a small wooden fishing boat and nets on the water, a charcoal fire on the beach; first-century Galilean fishing village setting","timeOfDay":"Early morning at daybreak, after a night of fishing; the scene spans the transition from night into dawn","weather":"Clear, calm morning with still water and light mist lifting off the lake","light":"Soft pale dawn light low over the water, warming to golden sunrise tones; the fire glows warmly against the cool morning","clothing":"Linen and wool tunics, fringed mantles and head coverings; fishermen in short work tunics; Peter stripped of his outer coat while fishing, otherwise plain Galilean dress"}

parsed.place: Shore of the Sea of Galilee (Tiberias) with a small wooden fishing boat and nets on the water, a charcoal fire on the beach; first-century Galilean fishing village setting
